title: ISSM: run the canonical shelf
chapter_timing: Receipt-bound logical chapters include control cue, actual transition and confirmation; durations are video times.

steps.title: Your goal: run the native ISSM example
instructions: Launch SquareIceShelf with its supplied inputs, inspect speed and save the results ZIP.
Start with an approved cloud account, configured MATLAB license and any required Connector.
Open CryoLauncher and sign in. Use an approved connected cloud account with its resources prepared.
The following steps select this tutorial’s model and example.
steps.why: Keep the source inputs, inspect native fields, and save a complete result package. Your workspace keeps scripts, dataset references and results together.
steps.expected: Your workspace keeps scripts, datasets, run history and results together.
steps.note: Use the separate account and MATLAB guides if these prerequisites are not ready. Shared application orientation; the case-specific configuration follows.

steps.title: 1. Choose the Basic shelf case
instructions: Choose Cloud → Basic → ISSM → SquareIceShelf.
Basic uses the supplied example; no script upload or workspace clone is needed.
steps.why: Basic keeps the supplied scientific workflow and exposes its reviewed controls.
steps.expected: Keep runme.m as the Run target; no script upload is needed.
steps.note: Keep the Run target as runme.m.

steps.title: 2. Keep the supplied scientific inputs
instructions: Leave the optional Basic overrides disabled.
The 1,000 km square shelf tapers from 1,000 m to 300 m along y and solves a steady SSA stress-balance problem.
steps.why: Basic retains the supplied example; optional edits change its scientific input definition.
steps.expected: The 1,000 km shelf tapers from 1,000 m to 300 m along y.
steps.note: The four supplied files are runme.m, Square.par, DomainOutline.exp and Front.exp.

steps.title: 3. Confirm cloud readiness
instructions: Check Account connected and Storage, Containers and Compute Ready.
Use Prepare cloud if your account resources are not ready, then review again.
steps.why: Storage, image, compute and MATLAB access must be ready before AWS can execute the model.
steps.expected: Use Prepare cloud first if the account resources are not ready.
steps.note: This run used 2 vCPU, 8 GiB and a 60-minute time limit.

steps.title: 4. Open the review
instructions: Choose Review & Launch.
Confirm ISSM and SquareIceShelf in the review.
Check the tested container image and pinned digest.
steps.why: Review confirms the intended model, source, resources and charges before submission. The tested image and pinned digest identify the native software environment.
steps.expected: AWS charges the connected account; the displayed price is an estimate.
steps.note: Reviewing shows the configuration before a paid run is submitted. AWS charges the connected account; the displayed price is an estimate.

steps.title: 5. Submit the reviewed run
instructions: When all readiness rows are Ready, choose Launch cloud run.
CryoLauncher stages the inputs and submits the native job.
The execution summary retains ISSM, SquareIceShelf and runme.m.
steps.why: This final confirmation submits a paid job to the connected AWS account. Review confirms the intended model, source, resources and charges before submission.
steps.note: Check the ISSM runtime row before confirming. The script requests two MPI processes.

steps.title: 6. Let the native job finish
instructions: Allow the job to complete, then open its results.
Submission → container start: 214.4 s. Batch task: 42.8 s.
The job succeeded with native exit code 0.
Runtime provenance records MATLAB R2024b Update 7 and ISSM 2026.1.
steps.why: Submission, queue/startup and native model execution are separate stages. A completed native job and its recorded provenance provide execution evidence.
steps.expected: MATLAB R2024b Update 7 · ISSM 2026.1 · exit code 0.
steps.note: Long setup, queue and observation waits are shortened in this guide. The configured license path supported native execution.

steps.title: 7. Render a speed field
instructions: Open Results, select StressbalanceSolution → Vel, then use Render when needed.
Vel contains 91 nodal speed values.
The native mesh has 91 vertices and 148 triangles.
steps.why: The solution, field name, units and mesh counts identify what you are viewing.
steps.expected: Four physical arrays, 91 mesh vertices and 148 triangles.
steps.note: The first field may be previewed automatically. The four physical arrays are Vx, Vy, Vel and Pressure.

steps.title: 8. Inspect the full saved velocity map
instructions: Open the full saved Vel PNG.
Colour is speed in m/year; x and y are metres. Speed spans 0–9034.387288 m/year.
steps.why: The unchanged saved figure preserves the complete map, axes and colour scale.
steps.expected: Speed: 0–9034.387288 m/year; x and y are metres.
steps.note: 10⁶ m equals 1,000 km. The saved PNG is unchanged.

steps.title: 9. Separate the diagnostic from time
instructions: The native convergence count is 23 steps.
It describes steady stress-balance convergence, not 23 transient timesteps.
steps.why: A steady diagnostic convergence count is different from a transient time axis.
steps.note: Vel agrees with hypot(Vx, Vy); all four physical fields are finite.

steps.title: 10. Generate your result download
instructions: Choose Download results.
Open the generated HTTPS link and save the ZIP.
The package includes native fields, mesh, final MATLAB model, figure and provenance.
steps.why: The archive keeps this run’s numeric outputs, figures and provenance together.
steps.expected: Keep its 11 members: fields, mesh, model, figure and provenance.
steps.note: Wait for the fresh archive link for this run. This archive contains 11 members and passed its CRC check.

steps.title: Keep the inputs and results together
instructions: Retain the four source files, result ZIP, versions, hashes and saved MATLAB RNG state.
All four physical fields and the mesh match the declared reference exactly.
steps.why: Keep the source, versions, hashes and scientific qualifications with the result.
steps.expected: All four physical fields and the mesh match the declared reference exactly.
steps.note: This is the supplied synthetic diagnostic case; it is not a field-data forecast.
